scope: Keep the retained heroic jewelry loot while translating its generated NGE weapon action-cost expertise roll to the corresponding Publish 14.1 weapon-speed skill modifier consumed by the authoritative PRE-CU cadence path.

findings: Publish 14.1 attack cadence sums the weapon template's category speed modifiers plus the authored private and generic melee/ranged speed modifiers; it has no weapon action-cost expertise statistic.
The restored x64 command queue maps the ten retained jewelry categories to their authenticated Publish 14.1 *_speed modifiers and consumes the enhanced modifier in calculatePrecuAttackTime.

The inherited heroic jewelry generator produced expertise_action_weapon_<type>, which is consumed only by the later non-PRE-CU action-cost path and therefore had no valid authority under the restored three-pool HAM cost model.
All twenty-six jewelry definitions and all seventy-two heroic loot-table placements are retained content; only the generated weapon-efficiency modifier is translated.
